sn35.73:1.1: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam nappajānāti ||
sn35.73:1.2: avusitam tena brahmacariyam ārakā so imasmā dhammavinayā ti || || 3
sn35.73:2.1: Evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.73:2.3: ahañhi bhante channam phassayātanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāmīti || || 4
sn35.73:3.2: cakkhuṃ niccaṃ vā aniccaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.73:5.1: Yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vā ti || ||

sn35.73:7.2: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.73:9.5: Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||

sn35.73:15.1: Evam passam bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || manasmim pi nibbindati || ||
sn35.73:15.2: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || vimuttasmiṃ vimuttam iti ñāṇaṃ hoti || ||
sn35.73:15.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyam nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
